title: Good Coffee... Until
text:
Good Coffee... Until. I really like this coffee maker. It works well. It makes a fantastic pot of coffee. It does work with a reusable filter, which is what I prefer, though it did not come with one. The coffee hopper seals so my coffee does stay fresh in there. However, a coffee pot that has a hopper like this really should be grinding the coffee. This one doesn’t do that. It makes it very clear it doesn’t do that. But why wouldn’t you make it with a grinder in it? That would make this pot PERFECT instead of good. You have to put ground coffee in the hopper. It holds 12 oz. of grounds max. You can skip the hopper if you are making a different kind of coffee that day. But it does not grind. So, good coffee maker. Could have been the perfect coffee maker.
Update: After a couple months with this coffee pot, it is now not brewing well at all. It was pretty good at first. Then it started half brewing the grinds. Like, it would dump them, but the water would pool around the edges and not go through the coffee, so you end up with dirty water instead of coffee. And you end up wasting a full pot’s worth of good coffee. I’m not sure why it worked so well for two months and now this. The pot is basically trash now.

product_metadata.title: Hamilton Beach 45400 12 Cup Programmable Coffee Maker, Automatic Grounds Dispensing for Pre-Ground Coffee, Black
features: AUTOMATIC GROUNDS DISPENSING WITH MEMORY. This coffee maker stores and dispenses the grounds for you and remembers the scoop number you previously selected. Store up to 12 ounces of ground coffee – the sealed container keeps coffee tasting fresh.
CONSISTENT FLAVOR, NO MATTER WHO MAKES IT. Trust anyone to make the coffee the way you prefer - just select your preferred scoop number, add water and brew.
EASY ACCESS FROM THE FRONT. Fill the water reservoir from the front of the coffee maker, not the back. View water levels in the window that’s on the front.

SWING-OUT BREW BASKET WITH INTELLIGENT SENSOR. Brew basket opens with a push of a button, and an intelligent sensor alerts you if the basket needs to be cleaned out before dispensing grounds, so you never have to worry about accidentally auto filling into a used filter.
12 CUP CAPACITY WITH BREWING FLEXIBILITY. Programmable timer with auto shutoff and optional clean cycle reminder. Brewing options include regular, bold, and 1-4 cups.
No need to scoop grounds every time — coffee maker stores and automatically dispenses the grounds for you
Consistent coffee flavor no matter who makes it
Sealed grounds container helps keep coffee tasting fresh
Holds up to 12 ounces of ground coffee, brews up to 12 cups
Has memory for last number of scoops selected — no need to set scoop number daily
description: With the Hamilton Beach auto grounds dispensing Coffee maker there is no need to scoop Coffee grounds every time you want to brew a carafe of Coffee. Simply select the number of scoops, pour in the water and the Coffee maker dispenses pre-ground Coffee from the seal-tight grounds container into the brew basket.
